At least 7 years of experience in Demand Planning, Supply Chain Planning or Forecasting within a manufacturing environment. Advanced analytical skills and extensive experience with Excel and Business Intelligence tools. Experience with Lean, Kaizen or other Continuous Improvement methodologies. Strong stakeholder management skills and experience working directly with customers. The ability to translate data into practical business decisions. Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken. Medewerker Filet American - Zoetermeer -  €14,99 per hour - Productie - 40 uur Do you aspire to develop a career in food production? Would you like to work for one of the largest production companies specializing in meat products? As a filet amerivan Employee, you'll be part of a friendly and hardworking team. You'll help ensure that our products are made and packaged with care. Your daily tasks will include: - Allround production work on the line or near machines - Packing containers with our delicious products - Assisting in the preparation of vegan filet - an important part of our product range - Filling machines with toppings to keep production running smoothly Start times vary between 05:00 and 08:00 depending on the department, and most shifts last around 8 hours, Monday through Friday. Extra hours or weekend work may be scheduled based on operational needs.  Functievereisten  - You are interested in production work and want to be part of the production process. - Experience is not a must, you can learn everything from the team at Luiten. It is more important to be enthusiastic and motivated. - You are able to lift 5 to 8 kg and able to stand for a longer time. - You speak English and/or Dutch. - You are able to work in a cold environment, as it's 7 degrees in the production hall. - You are available during peak periods (December and Easter). - Willingness to adhere to regulations regarding jewelry, nail polish and artificial nails, which are prohibited in food production environments.  Arbeidsvoorwaarden  - Employment contract with Charlie works. - Health Insurance. - Housing at a close distance. - Electrical bike for transport to work. - Friendly, multi-cultural, proud colleagues with a heart for production and a passion for quality. - A cold environment allowance of €0,09 per hour. - Annual December bonus of 3,25% of gross salary (with the condition of working at least 2 months in Luiten).
